ModMetaData.name: Eugenics Program
ModMetaData.author: tylerkilburn
ModMetaData.description:
A dystopian RimWorld Biotech expansion centered on two distinct systems:
1. Germline Gene Editing: Precision laboratory editing of natural human embryos (capped at 2 edits per embryo) with instant cellular collapse on failure and emotional reactions from biological parents. 2. Constructs (SecUnits): Industrial synthesis of donorless artificial human matrices, modular bio-augment packages across four technical disciplines, stasis hibernation cycles, and reusable neural imprint doctrines streamed directly into growth vats.
